title: Dean Koontz novel predicting COVID and the Wuhan lab
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Dean Koontz novel predicting COVID and the Wuhan lab, about 2020 at Wuhan, China, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a sci-fi author Dean Counz who predicted COVID the Wuhan lab.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a science fiction writer named Dean Koontz predicted COVID, the pandemic disease of 2020, and the laboratory in Wuhan, China, that the outbreak has been linked to. Michels raises it as an example of fiction seeming to see the future, which, if true, would hint that writers can sometimes know things before they happen.
